caption:
And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good.

Surah Al-A'raf (7:56). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #IslamicReminder #Ayah #Deen #IslamicGuidance

sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Two independent live fetches this session (2026-11-26) of GET /v1/ayah/7:56/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese, HTTP 200 each, diffed: byte-identical. Verbatim: "وَلَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَٰحِهَا وَٱدْعُوهُ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًا ۚ إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ"
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (en.sahih). Verbatim: "And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good."
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian (zh.jian). Raw: "在改善地方之后，你们不要在地方上作恶，你们要怀著恐惧和希望的心情祈祷他。真主的慈恩确是临近行善者的。". Used verbatim.
sourcing.korean: ko.korean; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', credited on-slide as not specified. Raw: "하나님께서 정돈 하셨으니 지상에서 해악을 끼치지 말라 그 리고 그분을 두려워하고 갈망하라하나님의 은혜는 선을 행하는 이 들 가까이에 있노라". Spacing-only fix: '정돈 하셨으니' -> '정돈하셨으니'; '그 리고' -> '그리고'; '이 들' -> '이들'. Whitespace-stripped text verified identical to raw. No wording changed.
sourcing.japanese: ja.japanese; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', cited as such. Verbatim: "秩序が定められた後，地上で悪を行ってはならない。恐れと熱情をもってかれに祈れ。本当にアッラーの慈悲は，（常に）善行をなす者の近くにある。"
